email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with puffy face and lips
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 34-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 10mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-28.
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed puffy face and lips.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Kim (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter442@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
